title: Corporations Act 2001 ss.248F, 251A and 251B
source: Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), Compilation No. 149, 19 September 2026. Read on legislation.gov.au 2026-10-09.

rules.text: Proceedings and resolutions of directors' and members' meetings are recorded in the minute books within one month.
The chair of the meeting, or of the next meeting, signs the minutes within a reasonable time.
Two directors are a quorum unless the directors decide otherwise; the minutes say one was present.
Members may inspect the members' minute books free of charge and have a copy within 14 days.
